known_engine_limitations.description: txexs U+F8EE classified as 'brace' instead of 'bracket' by CMEX10 table
known_engine_limitations.proposed_fix: Add txexs font-family branch in classify_delimiter_glyph_font_aware

known_engine_limitations.description: LMMathExtension10 U+000D (/vextenddouble) not in standard or CMEX tables
known_engine_limitations.proposed_fix: Add encoding-aware PostScript glyph-name resolver for /vextenddouble

known_engine_limitations.description: Enclosure bbox anchored to delimiter pair y-span only; multi-line expressions not covered
known_engine_limitations.proposed_fix: Vertical content-scan pass within delimiter band in build_enclosure_completeness

known_engine_limitations.description: associate_delimiter_pairs pairs at geometric score 0.70 without kind-match (soft penalty, not hard gate)
known_engine_limitations.proposed_fix: Convert kind-match to hard precondition. Must operate on logical delimiter identity, not physical glyph classification, to avoid rejecting legitimate extensible delimiter assemblies.

positive_findings.finding: dim_5_boundary_isolation PASS in all three cases
positive_findings.significance: External isolation generalized across TX Fonts, Computer Modern, and Latin Modern Math typographies. The crop-boundary mechanism survived changes in font program and mathematical structure even when delimiter classification failed entirely.

positive_findings.finding: NEG_MISSING_CLOSING_PARTNER PASS in all three cases
positive_findings.significance: Unpaired opening candidates correctly preserved as structural candidates, not silently dropped.

positive_findings.finding: NEG_INTERVENING_DELIMITER_COLLISION PASS in all three cases
positive_findings.significance: Adjacent delimiter pairs correctly separated by intervening-delimiter guard.

positive_findings.finding: NEG_TALL_NON_MATH_GRAPHIC PASS in all three cases
positive_findings.significance: Tall non-math regions classified as unknown/low-confidence in all three distinct page contexts.

Standard CMR10 bracket recognition, sequence vector structure retention, semantic fidelity, and boundary isolation all pass for ViLT. The single FAIL is dim_1 (enclosure bbox anchoring), not classification.
